limits.en: Up to 5 private/shared lists, up to 5 people per shared list, unlimited tasks and notes, 25MB uploads and 500MB storage.

keyLimits.en: Up to 5 private/shared lists, up to 5 people per shared list, unlimited tasks and notes, 25MB uploads and 500MB storage.
Unlimited lists/sublists, unlimited team members, all integrations, voice AI for tasks, 100MB uploads and 25GB storage.
Unlimited AI meeting notes and AI chat messages, AI generation (Make AI), email and Slack task summarization.

cautions.en: Annual per-seat prices were derived from the stated yearly totals ($59/year for Basic, $249/year for Super) divided by 12; the page lists these as yearly amounts rather than an explicit monthly-equivalent figure.

capabilities.en: Personal and team task management app with shared lists, sublists, and native apps for macOS, iOS, Android, and web.
AI features on paid plans: voice-to-task capture, AI meeting notes, AI chat, and email/Slack task summarization.

limitations.en: Free plan caps shared lists at 5 people and 5 lists total, restrictive for growing teams.
Storage and upload limits are modest even on Basic (100MB uploads, 25GB storage) compared to general-purpose cloud storage tools.

reason.en: Direct competitor task-management app with a comparable free tier and paid plans.
Broader workspace tool frequently used for task lists and personal/team organization.

missingAlternatives.name: Things 3
missingAlternatives.reason: Premium task manager alternative, though one-time purchase rather than subscription.

unknowns: Whether 'unlimited team members' on paid plans has any soft cap or fair-use limit was not stated on the pricing page.
